newsitem.title: USA: GTE files $2.5 bln shelf offering of debt.
newsitem.headline: GTE files $2.5 bln shelf offering of debt.

text.p: GTE Corp filed Tuesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register a shelf offering of up to $2.5 billion in debt securities to be issued as medium-term notes.
Together with previously registered securities, the company's shelf offering totals $3 billion.
Underwriters for the offering are Goldman Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co and Salomon Brothers Inc.
Proceeds from the sale will be used to repay short term debt, to fund investments in the company's subsidiaries and for other corporate needs.
